scheme_name: Yashwantrao Chavan Mukta Vasahat Yojana for VJNTs
other_conditions: Family must belong to the original VJNT (Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes) category
Family must not own a house
Family must be residing in a tent house or hut
Family must have been residing in one place for at least six months and wandering from village to village for livelihood during the remaining months
Annual income of the family must be less than ₹1,00,000 per year
Family must not have availed benefits of any other housing scheme such as Gharkul
Benefit of the scheme is given to only one member of the eligible family
Priority is given to families living in tents, with no‑earning hand widows, divorcees, handicapped and flood‑affected persons
benefits_summary: Each eligible VJNT family receives a 5‑guntha (≈500 m²) land plot with a 269‑sq‑ft house and basic amenities such as roads, drainage, water, electricity and a community hall.
